name: net-lab
description: Net+ Visual Lab - a tiny Packet Tracer for learning networking, inspired by Tech With Diego's Network Lab 101

scripts.deploy: npm run build && TOKEN=$(az staticwebapp secrets list --name net-lab --resource-group personal-portfolio-rg --query properties.apiKey -o tsv) && npx --yes @azure/static-web-apps-cli deploy ./dist --api-location ./api --api-language node --api-version 20 --deployment-token $TOKEN --env production
